row.notes: Calls Career_MyTeamSetupRecord_InitDefault(rec) then fills it from the live career: finds the player's entrant in career+0x2e0..0x2e8 by local player id, copies the team name string (team record +0xb8, 0x80 bytes) to rec+0x58/+0x60 and team colours/ids (team +0x564..+0x578) to rec+0x14..+0x34, sets rec+0xe0 entrant id, +0xe8 vehicle customisation id, +0xf0/+0xf8 driver ids, +0xfc sponsor slot from CareerSponsorsComponent, +0xe4/+0xec player customisation and assigned badge, and from OwnerSetupComponent the owner name strings at rec+0x108 and rec+0x1a0 plus +0x230..+0x260. Validity flags at rec+0x38..+0x3f. Good hook to read or override MyTeam identity when continuing a save or entering Team HQ.
